newsitem.title: USA: PSE&G believes rate cuts possible.
newsitem.headline: PSE&G believes rate cuts possible.

text.p: Public Service Electric & Gas Co believes multi-year rate cuts totaling 5 to 10 percent sought by New Jersey regulators through industry restructuring are possible, vice-president - marketing Fritz Lark said Tuesday.

Testifying at the first of three hearings on the state's energy plan, he told the New Jersey Board of Public Utilities the Public Service Enterprise Group Inc subsidiary backs the plan's objectives of lower power costs and customer choice.
The New Jersey Energy Master Plan, released on January 16, aims to begin opening the New Jersey energy marketplace to competition in October 1998.
